5
Association of Sri Lanka (Incorporation)

5.
(1) Subject to the general control and direction of the
Spiritual Head, the management and administration of the
Corporation  shall  be  carried  out  by  a  Board  of  Trustees
consisting  of  such  number  of  office  bearers  as  may  be
appointed by the Spiritual Head.
(2) The  Spiritual  Head  of  the  Corporation  shall  be  the
Life Patron of the Corporation as long as he continues to be
such Spiritual Head.
(3) At the coming into operation of this Act, His Holiness
As-Shaikh Afdhalul Ulama Dr. Thaika Shuaib Alim, B.A.
(Hons)., M.A., ph. D., M.F.A, Jalali, the present Officiating
Shaikh of the Association shall be the Spiritual Head of the
Corporation and shall hold office for life.
(4) The Spiritual Head shall have full power and authority
in his discretion to nominate a successor. Such nomination
shall be in accordance with the rules and will become operative
upon the death or incapacity of the incumbent Spiritual Head.
The  Spiritual  Head  may  in  his  absolute  discretion  delegate
any of his powers and functions to such persons as he may
think fit and for such period as may be prescribed by him.
Notwithstanding  any  delegation  of  any  such  powers  or
functions, the Spiritual Head may at any time exercise any
such powers or functions delegated or revoke such delegation
without notice to the person or persons to whom such powers
or functions has been delegated.
(5)  The  successors  to  the  Spiritual  Head  shall  in
descending order be—

(i)
His Holiness As-Shaikh Afzalul Ulama Ahmad Nasir
Thaika  Shuaib  also  known  as  Thaika  Nasir  Alim
Jalali,  B.A.  (His.),  M.F.A.,  Faazil  Jamaali,  and
thereafter shall be;

(ii)
His Holiness As-Shaikh Yaseen Mujeerudeen also
